purpose: Collapse the explicit even-character sum inside each occurrence group by exterior-algebra character orthogonality. This removes the 2^(q-n) Fourier enumeration symbolically, but does not yet provide a polynomial algorithm for the remaining top-coefficient extraction.

setup.augmented_determinant: For the occurrence-rank1 construction, write the fixed top rows of [[M0,U],[-T V^T,I+T]] as R. For occurrence o, write its bottom row as w_o(t)=a_o+t b_o with a_o=[0|e_o] and b_o=[-v_o^T|e_o], t in {+1,-1}.
setup.groups: For original variable i, O_i is its occurrence set, d_i=|O_i|. The Fourier equality projector restricts signs to product_{o in O_i} t_o=1.
setup.ordering: Fix one global row order with occurrences grouped by original variable. Any permutation from the source occurrence order contributes one fixed sign only; the checker normalizes the same order on both sides.

local_identity.name: EVEN_CHARACTER_WEDGE_PROJECTOR
local_identity.statement: For any ordered group G of size d>=1, sum over t in {+-1}^G with product t=1 of wedge_{o in G}(a_o+t_o b_o) = 2^(d-1) (A_G+B_G), where A_G=wedge_{o in G} a_o and B_G=wedge_{o in G} b_o.
proof: Expand the wedge product by the subset S of positions at which b_o is chosen.
The coefficient of the S-term is sum_{product t=1} product_{o in S} t_o.
The even-sign subgroup has annihilator {empty,G}; hence this character sum equals 2^(d-1) for S=empty or S=G and equals 0 otherwise.
Only the all-a and all-b blades survive.

global_identity.statement: Let q be the total occurrence count and n the number of nonempty variable groups. Then the previous identity #SAT(F)=2^(n-q) sum_{t in E} det([[M0,U],[-T V^T,I+T]]) becomes exactly #SAT(F) = [top] R wedge product_i (A_i+B_i).
global_identity.power_of_two_cancellation: product_i 2^(d_i-1)=2^(q-n), exactly cancelling the Fourier prefactor 2^(n-q).
global_identity.assignment_expansion: Expanding product_i(A_i+B_i) chooses one of two coherent blades per original variable. Choosing A_i sets all occurrence-copy bits of variable i to 0; choosing B_i sets them all to 1. Schur complementation then gives det(M0+U D_x V^T), exactly the Boolean clause-indicator product for assignment x. Therefore the top coefficient is sum_x 1[F(x)=1]=#SAT(F).

positive: The explicit 2^(q-n) Fourier-character sum is eliminated symbolically.
Each original variable contributes only one constant-degree two-blade-choice factor A_i+B_i; under bounded occurrence d_i<=3.
All coefficients and vector coordinates remain polynomial-bitlength integers.
algorithmic_meaning.missing: No polynomial-time method is proved for extracting the top coefficient of R wedge product_i(A_i+B_i) for arbitrary formulas. Expanding the two coherent blade choices is still 2^n in the worst case.
algorithmic_meaning.known_boundary: When all variable factors were degree-2 alternating forms, Pfaffian machinery would be the natural comparison. The degree-3 mixed-variable factors are the first non-Pfaffian layer; generic higher-order hyperpfaffian evaluation is known to be VNP-complete, so no generic hyperpfaffian subroutine may be assumed polynomial.

next_target.name: E8_SOURCE_ALIGNED_TWO_BLADE_TOP_COEFFICIENT_CONTRACTION_V2_6
next_target.directive: Exploit the special vectors a_o=[0|e_o], b_o=[-v_o|e_o], clause-block locality of v_o, and d_i<=3. Seek a polynomial-size contraction/determinant/Pfaffian-like representation of [top] R wedge product_i(A_i+B_i) that does not expand 2^n coherent choices. Immediately reject generic exterior-state DP, generic hyperpfaffian evaluation, or any representation whose middle exterior degree has exponential dimension.
success_obligations: exact SAT iff resulting invariant is nonzero (or exact #SAT)
polynomial witness reconstruction by self-reduction if decision-only
no hidden exponential basis, field extension, coefficient size, branching, or oracle

scientific_ceiling.NEW_EXACT_RESULT: The equality Fourier projector factors locally into an all-a plus all-b exterior blade with exact cancellation of every mixed local occurrence state.
